## Summary

Describe the change and its public evidence.

## Data contribution checklist

- [ ] I used the relevant issue form or distributed-energy submission template.
- [ ] The submission validator passes.
- [ ] Public source URLs and access dates are included.
- [ ] Coordinate precision is labelled honestly.
- [ ] I checked for nearby or name-based duplicates.
- [ ] I recorded source-specific licence or reuse terms.
- [ ] I did not edit generated API or website data directly.
- [ ] `make validate PYTHON=.venv/bin/python` passes.

## Rights and limitations

- [ ] I have the right to contribute my own work.
- [ ] I preserved the terms and attribution of referenced third-party sources.
